enriched.title: Present Perfect e Vocabulário de Cozinha
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso de tempos verbais, com foco no Present Perfect, e apresenta um vocabulário extenso relacionado à cozinha e alimentos. Além disso, inclui dicas de pronúncia e exemplos práticos para reforçar o aprendizado.
mainTopics: Pronúncia de palavras relacionadas a alimentos

vocabulary.definition: To allow liquid or gas to pass through a hole or crack.
examples: The pipe has a leak. (O cano tem um vazamento.)
Water is leaking from the faucet. (A água está vazando da torneira.)

vocabulary.definition: To take something apart into separate pieces.
examples: We need to disassemble the furniture before moving it. (Precisamos desmontar os móveis antes de movê-los.)

vocabulary.definition: Unclean matter, such as dust or mud.
examples: There is dirt on the floor. (Há sujeira no chão.)
The dishes are dirty. (Os pratos estão sujos.)
There is grease on the pan. (Há gordura na panela.)

vocabulary.definition: A mark made by a substance such as dirt that is difficult to remove.
examples: There is a stain on your shirt. (Há uma mancha na sua camisa.)
The shirt shrank in the wash. (A camisa encolheu na lavagem.)

vocabulary.definition: A dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid.
examples: I made a beef stew for dinner. (Eu fiz um cozido de carne para o jantar.)

vocabulary.definition: Milk thickened by removing water and adding sugar.
examples: Condensed milk is used in desserts. (Leite condensado é usado em sobremesas.)

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions that happened at an unspecified time in the past or actions that started in the past and continue to the present.
rules: Often used with words like 'already', 'yet', 'just', 'ever', and 'never'.
examples: Birds have had serious problems because of light pollution. (Os pássaros têm tido sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.)
commonMistakes: Using the wrong auxiliary verb (e.g., 'Birds has had' instead of 'Birds have had').
Confusing Present Perfect with Simple Past.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Birds ______ serious problems because of light pollution.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Perfect is used to describe a situation that started in the past and is still relevant in the present.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate to English: 'Os pássaros estão tendo sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Birds are having serious problems because of light pollution.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Continuous is used to describe an action happening right now.

culturalNotes: Condensed milk is a staple ingredient in many Brazilian desserts, such as brigadeiros and pudim.
Non-stick frying pans are commonly used in modern kitchens to reduce the need for oil or butter while cooking.
studyTips: Practice conjugating the irregular verbs listed in the lesson to improve your fluency.
Use flashcards to memorize the new vocabulary and their translations.
Try to create your own sentences using the Present Perfect to describe past events.
originalExamples: Birds have serious problems because of light pollution. (Os pássaros têm sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.)
Birds are having serious problems because of light pollution. (Os pássaros estão tendo sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.)
Birds had serious problems because of light pollution. (Os pássaros tiveram sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.)
